title: Memory
heading: What {{name}} remembers about me
intro: Memory is per account: each member has their own profile and memories, which others (managers included) cannot see. The assistant only suggests — nothing is remembered until you approve it.

backup.help: Off by default. When on, your memory is also stored on the server so you can restore it on another computer; only you can read it (not even managers).
